bad_guidance.why: Core record about details screen / watchlist / resume rows, selected on lexical overlap ('row', 'selected'); says nothing about focus visibility.
aria-rowcount / windowed rendering for the 'performance' concern on a SwiftUI LazyHStack rail that already virtualises.

No record states the focus-indicator contrast rule (a11y-focus-visible: >=3:1 vs the unfocused state, obvious at 3 m) or TV dark-palette contrast (tv-dark-first); both were candidates and fell to the cap because a11y.contrast was only a recommended concept.

misses.what: MISSING 'platform: only inferred from wording; confirm' although the project inspection carries 'Package.swift: tvOS target' KNOWN; downgrades guidance to PARTIAL (exit 3). Also accessibility.keyboard=true on a remote-only platform, and problem_domain=interaction for a visual/contrast defect.
a11y.contrast (and tv.dark_first) only recommended for 'nobody can tell which row is selected from the sofa'; a11y.reduced_motion never demanded although requirements set reduced_motion=true.

color-states-complete (0.458, web state-token framing) carried interaction.focus_visible while a11y-focus-visible / a11y-tv-focus-always / focus-scale-glow (0.36) — the TV-specific rules — were dropped; media-resume-and-details chosen as core on lexical 'row/selected'; comp-tv-rail rejected as 'no tv-rail evidence in the request' despite navigation=tv-rails KNOWN in project context.

10 of 13 slots 'new' for a moderate-budget fix on an existing app: typography-grotesk-display (contradicts system-font tvOS + stacks/swiftui), motion-crossfade, imagery-immersive-backdrop, metadata-focus-reveal, cards/layout marked new though CardRail/rails exist; navigation preserved slot maps tv-rails to nav-tv-side (the shell is top tabs); density text is web numbers.
focus-scale-glow gives 'border 2-4 dp' in the Android 960x540 frame with no tvOS 1080-pt translation; the app's 4 pt ring was in range and still failed at distance.

Context detection: tokens/typography/spacing/components UNKNOWN or [] although Theme/Tokens.swift defines explicit colour, type (76/48/34/29/23) and spacing (8/16/24/40/64) scales; radius evidence missed the 16 pt token.

knowledge_gaps: Row-level focus cue on rail screens (dim rails that do not hold focus, heading marker) — no record.
Focused-fill inversion (tvOS convention: focused control goes light, label dark) — no record; focus-scale-glow covers border/glow/scale only.
Ring thickness vs viewing distance (px -> arcmin at 3 m on a 55" panel) — no record; only Android dp ranges.
Focused-vs-unfocused fill contrast as a measurable (base has only indicator >=3:1 in a11y-focus-visible).

regressions.query: From the sofa nobody can tell which row is selected on the living-room screen. (tvOS project)
regressions.expect: a11y.contrast and interaction.focus_visible required; focus_visible carried by a11y-focus-visible or a11y-tv-focus-always rather than color-states-complete; a11y.reduced_motion at least recommended; no media-resume-and-details core.

regressions.expect: no MISSING platform-confirm entry; guidance status CONFIDENT.
